title: The Betrayer
summary: As Ha-Jun duels Captain Baek, his academy senior Park Jin-Woo reveals he traded Ha-Jun's coordinates for his sister's life-saving cure. The emotional conflict causes Ha-Jun to hesitate, leading to a catastrophic tactical breach.

panels.shot: captain baek drawing the eclipse greatsword
panels.action: Captain Baek swings the 200-pound jagged greatsword effortlessly in one hand, dark anti-mana humming.

panels.shot: captain baek charging forward like a meteor
panels.action: Baek kicks off the concrete, leaving a shattered crater as he rockets forward with devastating momentum.

panels.shot: greatsword clashing against ha-jun bone gauntlet
panels.action: Baek's greatsword slams into Ha-Jun's raised left bone gauntlet; a radial shockwave shatters all remaining glass.

panels.shot: concrete floor depressing under ha-jun boots
panels.action: The concrete under Ha-Jun's boots cracks into spiderwebs from the sheer kinetic pressure of Baek's blow.

panels.shot: captain baek grinning grimly behind visor
panels.action: Baek leans in with veins bulging on his neck: 'Tumhara bone armor sach mein impressive hai, ladke!'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Lekin technique bina experience ke sirf ek khilona hai!

panels.shot: baek executing spinning roundhouse kick
panels.action: Using the greatsword as a fulcrum, Baek swings his titanium-armored boot straight at Ha-Jun's ribs.

panels.shot: ha-jun parrying with right blood blade
panels.action: Ha-Jun pivots, his right blood katana sliding along Baek's armor to deflect the kick off-target.

panels.shot: ha-jun counter-thrusting toward baek throat
panels.action: Ha-Jun's flaming blood blade darts forward like a striking viper, aimed straight at the unarmored throat gap.

panels.shot: sudden gunshot from warehouse catwalk behind hajun
panels.action: A loud sniper gunshot rings out from the overhead catwalk, shattering the blood blade in mid-thrust.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping back in shock
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps back ten feet, his shattered blood reforming into his ring, eyes darting to the catwalk.

panels.shot: figure holding smoking hunting rifle on catwalk
panels.action: Standing on the catwalk: a slender 19yo boy in a Saint Mirren academy blazer, trembling violently.

panels.shot: ha-jun recognizing his senior park jin-woo
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes widen in genuine disbelief: 'Jin-Woo... Senior?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Jin-Woo Hyung...? Tum yahan kya kar rahe ho?!

panels.shot: jin-woo crying with rifle trembling in hands
panels.action: Park Jin-Woo weeps openly, tears streaming down his face as he aims the rifle at Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: jin_woo
dialogue.text: M-Mujhe maaf kar do, Ha-Jun! Mere paas koi aur raasta nahi tha!

panels.shot: jin-woo revealing his sick sister motive
panels.action: Jin-Woo holds up a glowing blue pharmaceutical vial in his left hand with desperate sobbing.

dialogue.speaker: jin_woo
dialogue.text: Meri behen Su-Jin terminal mana leukemia se mar rahi hai... Bureau ne kaha agar main tumhari location doon toh woh use cure denge!

panels.shot: ha-jun freezing with lowered blades
panels.action: Ha-Jun's arms slowly drop to his sides; the memory of his own lost brother paralyzes his battle instinct.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Apni behen ko bachaane ke liye... Woh bhi wahi kar raha hai jo mere bhai ne mere liye kiya.

panels.shot: kuro screeching frantically from rafters
panels.action: Kuro screams in terror: 'HA-JUN, DEFEND! BAEK IS MOVING! APNE EMOTIONS KO SIDE MEIN RAKHO!'

panels.shot: captain baek swinging eclipse greatsword at full power
panels.action: Taking full advantage of Ha-Jun's distraction, Captain Baek unleashes his ultimate strike.

panels.shot: greatsword cleaving straight through ha-jun bone gauntlet
panels.action: The anti-mana greatsword strikes Ha-Jun's left forearm with ungodly kinetic force, fracturing the bone plate.

panels.shot: ha-jun screaming as bone fractures
panels.action: Ha-Jun screams in visceral agony as the shockwave shatters his radius bone beneath the armor.

panels.shot: ha-jun thrown through three brick walls
panels.action: The titanic impact blasts Ha-Jun backward through three reinforced brick partition walls.

panels.shot: ha-jun lying in mountain of brick rubble
panels.action: Ha-Jun lies half-buried under crushed red bricks, blood pouring from his forehead and broken left arm.

panels.shot: captain baek walking through the dust cloud
panels.action: Captain Baek steps through the shattered archway, dragging his blood-stained greatsword.

panels.shot: baek looking at ha-jun with pity and respect
panels.action: Baek stops three feet away: 'Combat mein hesitation sirf maut laati hai, boy. Tumhara dil bohot naram hai.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Dushman par reham karna jung mein sabse bada gunaah hai.

panels.shot: baek raising greatsword high for finishing cleave
panels.action: Baek raises the massive blade two-handed, poised to plunge it directly into Ha-Jun's heart.

panels.shot: kuro diving down with blinding purple smoke bomb
panels.action: Kuro plunges between them, his wings exploding into a blinding 30-meter screen of choking purple demonic miasma.

panels.shot: baek coughing and slashing through smoke
panels.action: Baek swings blindly through the dense purple fog, but his blade strikes only empty air.

panels.shot: min-jae driving forklift through side wall
panels.action: Min-Jae smashes an industrial forklift through a corrugated metal side door into the smoke.

panels.shot: min-jae pulling unconscious ha-jun onto forklift pallet
panels.action: Min-Jae frantically drags Ha-Jun's limp, bleeding body onto the wooden pallet.

panels.shot: forklift reversing into rainy alleyway
panels.action: Min-Jae slams the forklift into reverse, bursting out into the pouring rain as smoke billows behind them.

panels.shot: captain baek emerging from smoke staring at rain
panels.action: Captain Baek lowers his sword, wiping purple soot from his cheek: 'Bhag gaye... Lekin uski haddiyan toot chuki hain.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Woh kal subah tak zinda nahi bachega.
